Read this before every generation; if a key is missing, run the setup flow in SKILL.md Step C (upload hero image -> create product -> save id back here). 'hero_image' paths below are placeholders -- supply your own local path to each brand's hero/product reference image when you run setup; there is no universal path that works outside the environment this cache was built in.
_workspace_note: This workspace ID is tied to one specific Higgsfield account. Verify it is still valid for your account before reusing it -- if not, run `higgsfield workspace status` and swap in your own.
